verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a workflow orchestration framework, so the axis applies. The pack never documents cron, recurring, or time-based triggers. Community mentions of LangGraph "scheduling" describe its internal Pregel-style node execution, not recurring job schedules. The Agent Server's run endpoints cover one-off invocation, not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
